fixed.explanation: sparsify_labels compares the formatted strings, so distinct level values that print identically (e.g. large floats shown as 2.015e+11) are treated as repeats and blanked. The fix passes the integer level codes as comparison keys, so sparsification depends on the real values and not on their text.

query.intent: MultiIndex string formatting for display sparsifies repeated labels by comparing formatted strings of level values rather than the underlying codes. It should sparsify based on the actual label codes/values so distinct values with identical formatted text are not collapsed.
query.symptom: With a MultiIndex whose first level has distinct floats that format identically, the display shows the first-level label once with blanks below, merging distinct groups.
